clue.text: Many people enthralled by shock via broadcast from composer

indicators.note: something enthralled by another is held captive inside it, so one piece sits within the other
broadcast seed is scattered about, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: a host is a large crowd or multitude

explanation.surface: A crowd of listeners is gripped by a shocking radio transmission of a composer's work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges SHOCK VIA into SAKOVICH, and HOST goes inside it after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: Dmitri Shostakovich was a twentieth-century Russian writer of symphonies and string quartets.

clue.text: French friend upset about English friend, the beast

indicators.note: about means around, so the reversed French word wraps the English one
in a down clue, upset turns the French word upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: ami is French for friend
pal is an everyday English word for a friend

explanation.surface: A tale of two friends, one French and one English, falling out over an animal.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' reads the French word bottom to top, giving IMA; 'about' splits it round the English friend.
explanation.definitionFit: The impala is an African antelope, so it is a beast in the sense of a wild animal.

clue.text: Friend runs after natural disaster

indicators.note: after places the runs abbreviation behind the disaster word

parts.note: a quake is an earthquake
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Someone flees in the aftermath of an earthquake.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Religious Society of Friends are commonly called Quakers.

clue.text: Anteater to stick around African country mostly

indicators.note: around tells us the stick word goes round the shortened country

parts.note: to pin is to stick or fasten

indicators.note: mostly means the country loses its final letter

parts.note: Angola is a country in southern Africa

explanation.surface: An anteater is being encouraged to stay put in an African country.
explanation.definitionFit: The pangolin is a scaly mammal that feeds on ants and termites, so it counts as an anteater.

clue.text: Chorister carrying priest's dog

indicators.note: carrying means holding inside, so the choir member contains the priest abbreviation

parts.note: a chorister is a singer in a choir

explanation.surface: A choir member is holding the vicar's pet dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A springer spaniel is a breed of gun dog used to flush game.

clue.text: Overdone food recalled in German city

parts.note: ham acting is overdone and exaggerated

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the food word is read backwards

parts.note: grub is slang for food

explanation.surface: An overcooked dish is withdrawn in a German city.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamburg is a major port city in northern Germany.

clue.text: Newspapers look ready to rise after brief time

indicators.note: after places the risen word behind the time abbreviation

parts.note: to gaze is to look steadily
T is a short form for time

indicators.note: in a down clue, to rise means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: set means ready, as in ready, steady, go

explanation.surface: Someone eyes the papers, ready to get up after a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A gazette is a journal or newspaper, especially an official one.

clue.text: Crustaceans, namely, linked to indications of current

parts.note: SC abbreviates scilicet, Latin for namely
amp, short for ampere, is the unit of electric current
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Shellfish, that is, attached to the signs of an electric or ocean current.
explanation.definitionFit: Scampi are langoustines, a type of lobster-like shellfish, usually served breaded.

clue.text: Greasy substance, mostly without much body

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter of the slippery word

parts.note: slime is a slippery, oily substance

explanation.surface: A greasy goo that has hardly any substance to it.
explanation.definitionFit: A slim figure is thin, having little bulk or flesh.

clue.text: Quantity of electricity or power brought into Channel Island

indicators.note: brought into means placed inside, so the island word contains the power letter

parts.note: Sark is one of the Channel Islands
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Electricity or energy is being supplied to a small island off France.
explanation.definitionFit: A spark is a small discharge of electrical energy.

clue.text: The current mood, I say, turning to follow it in enthusiasm

indicators.note: in places the middle pieces inside the enthusiasm word

parts.note: zest is keen enthusiasm or gusto

indicators.note: to follow puts the turned piece after the word it
turning means read backwards

parts.note: EG, for example, is what say means

explanation.surface: Someone describing the prevailing atmosphere becomes keen on following a trend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes GEI, placed 'to follow' it; the pair sit 'in' the enthusiasm word. 'Current' looks electrical but means present-day.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeitgeist is German for the spirit of the age, the prevailing outlook of a period.

clue.text: Nothing turned up in abandoned storeroom in Spanish resort

indicators.note: in tells us the reversed nothing word goes inside the rearranged letters
abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters are shuffled
in a down clue, turned up means read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: Nothing has surfaced in a deserted storeroom at a Spanish holiday town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' gives TORREMOOS; 'turned up', in a down clue, gives LIN, which goes 'in' after the first seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Torremolinos is a seaside holiday town on the Costa del Sol in southern Spain.

clue.text: Expedition in urban style? That's about right

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the style phrase wraps the right abbreviation

parts.note: a la means in the style of, so a la city is in city fashion

explanation.surface: A traveller asks whether a trip done the city way is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition here means promptness or speed, as in expeditious, which matches eager quickness.

clue.text: Weapon more than half of common soldiers backed

indicators.note: backed means sent backwards
more than half of means keeping five of the eight letters and dropping the rest

parts.note: regulars are rank-and-file soldiers of a standing army

explanation.surface: A gun used by most of the army's ordinary troops, who supported it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'more than half of' keeps REGUL; 'backed' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: The Luger is a German semi-automatic pistol, so it is a firearm.

clue.text: Made claim about ore not initially in veins?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the claim word wraps the shortened ore

parts.note: to stake a claim is to assert ownership, so staked is made claim

indicators.note: not initially removes the first letter of the word ore

explanation.surface: A prospector staked a claim on ore found in veins of rock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not initially' leaves RE, which the claim word goes 'about'. The question mark flags a definition by example: veined marble is streaked.
explanation.definitionFit: Something streaked has lines or stripes through it, like marble marked with veins.

clue.text: Some minor character — in Tolkien?

indicators.note: some means a part of, so the letters sit inside the two words

explanation.surface: A query about a bit-part figure in a Tolkien story.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across the join of 'minor character', and is itself such a figure in Tolkien.
explanation.definitionFit: Orcs are the brutish goblin soldiers of The Lord of the Rings, lowly figures in the story.

clue.text: Cleaner gets bored after disposing of one cathedral location

parts.note: a char is a cleaning lady

indicators.note: after disposing of means the bored word has lost a letter

parts.note: tires means bores or wearies
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A cleaner becomes bored after throwing something out at a cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: Chartres is a French town famous for its Gothic cathedral.

clue.text: Priest to stop working in Northern town

parts.note: to rest is to stop working or pause
on means working, as a machine that is switched on

explanation.surface: A clergyman stops work while living in a northern English town.
explanation.definitionFit: Preston is a city in Lancashire in north-west England.

clue.text: Display of information — mine's within reach, possibly? On the contrary

indicators.note: within marks containment, and the closing phrase swaps which piece holds which
on the contrary reverses the stated instruction, so the reach letters go inside the mine

parts.note: a pit is a mine

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters of reach may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: Is my information display within easy reach? No, the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' gives ECHAR; read literally 'within' would put the mine inside, but 'On the contrary' flips that, so the shuffled letters go inside the mine.
explanation.definitionFit: A circular graph divided into slices is a common visual way to present data.

clue.text: Eggs over easy? Not very

indicators.note: easy means loose or relaxed, so the letters of over are rearranged
not means the very abbreviation is excluded from the rearranged letters

explanation.surface: A breakfast order for eggs over easy, though not particularly so.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranging OVER and taking out the V leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Roe is the mass of eggs inside a female fish.

clue.text: Picture that is providing cover for publication

indicators.note: providing cover for means wrapping round, so the that is letters surround the publication

parts.note: IE abbreviates id est, Latin for that is
mag is short for magazine

explanation.surface: A photo that will serve as the cover of a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness.

clue.text: The Devil, represented in this poem

indicators.note: represented means presented again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Satan is depicted in the verse at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Mephisto, short for Mephistopheles, is the devil of the Faust legend.

clue.text: Way of working with Arab storage location

parts.note: the hang of something is the knack or way it works
AR is an abbreviation for Arab or Arabic

explanation.surface: A method of operating alongside an Arab, perhaps in a warehouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A hangar is a large shed for housing aircraft.

clue.text: Darker part was required in broadcast

indicators.note: in places the requirement word inside the scattering word

parts.note: to sow is to scatter seed broadcast
had, as in had to, means was required

explanation.surface: A shadowy segment was needed in a transmission.
explanation.definitionFit: A shadow is a dark area where light is blocked, as in the shaded parts of a painting.

clue.text: Battle field — cries of pain sending one away

indicators.note: sending, with away, means the letter is dispatched from the cries
sending away means the letter for one is removed from the cries

parts.note: moans are cries of suffering
A means one, as in a single item

explanation.surface: On a battlefield, wails of agony drive a soldier off.
explanation.definitionFit: Mons in Belgium was the site of a 1914 battle, the British army's first of the First World War.

clue.text: Problem with male film director

parts.note: a hitch is a problem or snag
a cock is a male bird

explanation.surface: A man causing trouble for a movie director.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Hitchcock was the director of thrillers such as Psycho and Vertigo.

clue.text: One enthusiast recalled going round a military institution

indicators.note: going round means the reversed letters surround the article
recalled means called back, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a fan is an enthusiast

explanation.surface: A supporter remembered visiting a forces establishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' turns I + FAN into NAFI, which goes round A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Navy, Army and Air Force Institutes run shops and canteens for the British forces.

clue.text: What judge does about introduction of this suit

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the judge word wraps the first letter

parts.note: a judge hears a case in court

indicators.note: introduction of means the opening letter of the word this

explanation.surface: A judge deals with the opening of a lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearts is one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards.

clue.text: Face unending contempt from audience about line on juggling performance?

indicators.note: unending means losing the final letter

parts.note: dial is slang for a face

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the jeer wraps the line letter

parts.note: a boo is a jeer of contempt from a crowd

explanation.surface: A performer faces endless jeers from the crowd over a juggling act.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabolo is a juggling game in which a spool is spun on a string between two sticks.
